# cli


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The `vishalakshi` command runs vault methods from a shell, for example
`vishalakshi grab https://example.com/post` or
`vishalakshi ask "why does late chunking help"`. `CMDS` lists the
methods it offers. Each one becomes a subcommand through
[`cmd`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/cli.html#cmd), which
builds the subcommand’s arguments from the method’s signature, so
`vishalakshi search --help` shows the same parameters and descriptions
as the documentation. Arguments that cannot be typed on a command line,
such as a function or a stand-in chat, are left out. Every command opens
the same vault: the file `$VISHALAKSHI_VAULT` names, else
`~/.vishalakshi/vault.db`, and `$VISHALAKSHI_OFFLINE` keeps it from
downloading a model. A result is printed as JSON, except an answer,
which is printed as prose with its citations.

### cmd

``` python
def cmd(
    name:str, vault_fn:functools._lru_cache_wrapper=vault
):
```

*Turn a
[`Vault`](https://vedicreader.github.io/vishalakshi/core.html#vault)
method into a plain function of the arguments a command line can give,
keeping their descriptions.*

### jsonable

``` python
def jsonable(
    o
):
```

*Make a value JSON-friendly for `json.dumps`: sequences become lists,
numpy scalars numbers, and anything else a string.*

## Try it

``` python
p = anno_parser(cmd('search'), prog='vishalakshi search')
p.print_help()
```

    usage: vishalakshi find [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--kind KIND] q

    Chunk-level hybrid search (FTS5 + vectors, RRF-fused), each hit carrying its breadcrumb.

    positional arguments:
      q              query

    options:
      -h, --help     show this help message and exit
      --limit LIMIT  hits to return (default: 10)
      --kind KIND    restrict to one or more KINDS ('note' or 'note,web')

``` python
args = p.parse_args(['late chunking', '--limit', '3', '--kind', 'note,web']).__dict__
test_eq(args['q'], 'late chunking'); test_eq(args['limit'], 3); test_eq(args['kind'], 'note,web')
test_eq(sorted(set(CMDS) - {m for m in dir(Vault) if not m.startswith('_')}), [])   # every command is a real method
test_eq(json.loads(json.dumps(L(['a', 'b']), default=jsonable)), ['a', 'b'])        # `L` is not a list; JSON needs telling
# a callable argument has no command-line spelling, so it is not offered as a flag
_ps = signature(cmd('ask')).parameters
assert 'chat' not in _ps and {'question', 'ref', 'model'} <= set(_ps), list(_ps)
assert {'suggest_noisy','mark_noisy','mark_pii','pii','accept_noisy'} <= set(CMDS)
assert {'level', 'set_level', 'set_floor', 'findings', 'send_check'} <= set(CMDS)
assert 'local_chat' not in signature(cmd('read_doc')).parameters
```
